[Documentation](../../docs.html) / [Question types](../../docs.html#question-types)

Add a question and choose Short text for a word or a line.

![SurveyStudio's Design screen with the short text question selected and its settings panel outlined.](../../../docs/question-types/short-text-editor.png){width=100%}

## What the respondent sees

![The short text question as the respondent sees it.](../../../docs/question-types/short-text-preview.png){width=90%}

## Settings

- **Required.** Tick it to require an answer before the respondent goes on. Leave open questions optional where you can.

## Best practices for research

Use a short text where the possible answers are too varied to list. Where the answers can be listed, a choice question is quicker to answer and to analyse.

Reference: Dillman, D. A., Smyth, J. D., & Christian, L. M. (2014). *Internet, phone, mail, and mixed-mode surveys: The tailored design method* (4th ed.). Wiley.
